sub_goals.name: codebase_explored
sub_goals.description: Evidence that the repository structure and issue-relevant source areas have been explored and understood.

sub_goals.name: issue_reproduced
sub_goals.description: Evidence that the reported bug has been reproduced with a concrete script or procedure.

sub_goals.name: fix_implemented
sub_goals.description: Evidence that a source-code fix addressing the root cause of the issue has been implemented.

sub_goals.name: fix_verified
sub_goals.description: Evidence that the implemented fix was verified by re-running reproduction and targeted tests.

sub_goals.name: patch_created
sub_goals.description: Evidence that a clean git patch containing only the fix changes was created.

sub_goals.name: patch_verified
sub_goals.description: Evidence that the generated patch was inspected and confirmed to contain only intended changes.

sub_goals.name: patch_submitted
sub_goals.description: Evidence that the final patch was submitted as the workflow output.
